source_review: Unchanged confirmed entry receives canonical checker/kit/slot/results roots and binding; the checker module is not substituted for entry execution.
The current CPU job and all four real native rank results must match original slot A and the native complete marker. Fixture, partial, foreign-job and failed results cannot qualify.
The baseline retains 20 normalized rows only after one stable-descriptor read authenticates every original row and the whole 86552359-byte prefix. The original attempt and saved binding must match.
The confirmed make_baseline API consumes these normalized rows; the loss policy is unchanged.

The baseline child has 512-MiB and 60-second limits. The parent reserves publication time and allows a 90-second child timeout. A failed or partial capture preserves CPU PASS but leaves baseline readiness false.
CPU-only exit 0 is not baseline readiness. Combined readiness requires CPU_PASS_BASELINE_READY, complete capture receipt, the pinned BASELINE.json and successful process exit.
Outputs are fresh and non-overwriting. The proposed destinations still need installation, permissions, canonical-path and placement preflight.
No wrapper path in either packet submits a GPU job or grants continuation authority.

Python source parsing and shell syntax
Manual entry, gate, capture, timeout and publication review
remaining_gates: Written installation/preflight and real CPU execution authority
